name: 🚨BARRY'S PRISON RUN! (OBBY)
desc:
Are you ready to break out of Prison?! Well let's do this! 💪
Today is Barry's Shift and he isn't exactly the most vigilant guard in the Prison. This gives us more of an advantage to make our escape.

(Note: Game is designed to be played in First Person but the choice is yours)

Barry's Prison Run - created by PlatinumFalls/FatPapsGamesLTD
